title: Cistercian 1657 complete bounded offertory: independent original-image and literal serialization collation
reviewer: Independent AI source reviewer (Cistercian 1657 original-image and literal serialization collation)
scope: Bounded functional offertory constituent within the native running head Ordo Missæ: from red Deinde osculatur Altare, & versus ad populum after the Creed on printed p. 172, through the complete Secreta/preface-transition rubric ending signum Crucis sibi producit à fronte ad pectus on p. 174, above the horizontal rule and ¶ Sequens Præfatio. Includes every intervening prayer, dialogue, black quoted incipit, sign and red rubric. This functional bound is not a printed native chapter heading. No earlier Creed or later preface belongs to the constituent.
method: The independent reviewer froze the full source extent before receiving the transcript, then read every literal prayer, spoken cue, alternative and red rubric on printed pp. 172-174 against the three retained original page images. Full-resolution decoder rasters of the same exact registered DjVu pages were used to disambiguate small accents, i/j forms and punctuation; their raw page hashes were matched to the retained registered originals. All 25 ordered units, including the reused unchanged Suscipe sancta Trinitas, were checked through the stated opening and closing bounds. The review preserves all interleaved Veni sanctificator, Orate/response and Secreta/preface rubrics, three printed crosses, one versicle cue and one response cue. It verifies 59 serialized literal line occurrences: 58 new-artifact lines and the one reused checked Suscipe line. Independent hashing and line-range reconstruction match every final unit hash, both literal artifact hashes, exact binding and census. ZIP page members and PDF JPEG extraction reproduce all three registered source-image hashes in page order.
normalization_limit: Accepted only under the exact normalization declared in the extent census: long-s and display-initial handling, explicit nasal-bar expansion, removed physical wraps/line-end word division, NFC text, conventional Unicode signs and separated crosses. Printed wording, u/v and i/j, ligatures, accents, punctuation, abbreviations, alternatives, source paragraphs and rubric/spoken order remain source-controlled. This is a normalized reading transcription, not a glyph-diplomatic color or type facsimile.
review_limit: Complete declared functional offertory constituent within native Ordo Missae only. It excludes the earlier Creed on p. 172 and the preface beginning below the rule on p. 174, and establishes neither complete Ordo/Missal text, whole-book coverage, adoption chronology, direct typesetting exemplar nor historical Git parentage. Whole-book stage coverage remains partial; no text inheritance or ancestry is authorized.
